packageRules.description: Low-risk updates merge themselves once CI is green. Majors and 0.x packages stay manual.
pub packages ship in the app: let a release sit for 3 days before it can automerge.
One PR for all GitHub Actions bumps (Renovate still splits major from non-major).
AGP sets a minimum Gradle version, so the plugin and the wrapper move in one PR.
JDK 17 is the release JDK verified reproducible against F-Droid. JDK 25 changes classes.dex (#96); raise this pin to try another.
The Flutter SDK pin is bumped deliberately (see the comment next to flutter-version in the workflows).
Ruby and fastlane only run in the release workflow, which PR CI never exercises, so a green PR proves nothing.
